issue.title: [Bug]: Failures in IPv6 mgmt test setup lead to lost mgmt IPs

failure.body:
### Issue Description

If the setup for IPv6 mgmt only tests fail (eg. bgp takes too long to come up, as seen in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/16436), the teardown fails to run, leading to the testbed being in a bricked state where the ipv4 mgmt IPs getting wiped.

### Results you see

Failure for test setup deletes ipv4 management addresses

### Results you expected to see

failure on test setup cleans up gracefully

resolution.title: [ip/test_mgmt_ipv6_only]: Refactor to properly cleanup on failure
resolution.description:
### Description of PR
ipv6 mgmt only tests can fail in setup, after config has been modified, leading to the teardown to not be run, and the duts to be left in an unreachable state. Refactor the test to split backing up and restoring the config into an independent fixture, such that failures in setting the mgmt IPs won't nuke the testbed. Also refactor / cleanup some other aspects of the tests to enhance clarity.

Summary:
Fixes #16441
